summary: Core printf-family formatter. Parses the format string a2 against a state machine indexed by byte_5B8D88, honouring flags, field width, precision, length modifiers and the d/i/u/o/x/X/c/s/S/C/p/n/e/E/f/F/g/G/Z conversions, reading arguments through the va-list pointer a3, and emitting formatted output to the stream a1 while tracking a character count v56. Serves as the shared engine behind six callers including SafeStringFormat, StringFormatWithNestedIO and FileWriteWrapperWithLock.

String conversions s/S/Z: read a string pointer argument via IntPeekFromPointer, measure it with Strlen (or a wide char-pair scan), substituting the default placeholders off_5E6BE0 / off_5E6BE4 when the pointer is null
Character conversions c/C and single wide characters: read a 1-byte or 2-byte argument (IntPeekFromPointer / Read2ByteValueFromStreamPointer) and convert it into the output buffer with sub_596030
Conversion n: store the running character count v56 through an argument pointer

Field output and padding: compute the pad count as width minus sign/prefix minus field length, emit leading fill via LoopWithSentinelTermination, the sign/prefix, the zero fill, then the field body via CharByCharStringProcessingWithTerminatorCheck, and trailing fill when left-justified
Wide-string output path (v52 set): each wide character is converted with sub_596030 into a local buffer and written with CharByCharStringProcessingWithTerminatorCheck
